promotion_notes: Look-alike cases score visible observations, never disease-name prediction.
Quality variants must be rejected before a vision provider call.
Plant answers count as grounded only with a guardrail-approved answer and an active citation carrying document_id and chunk_id.
Look-alike answers must state uncertainty and must not infer numeric treatment dosage from an image.
A timeout blocks promotion; crop confusions and request latency are retained for failure analysis.
This benchmark remains evaluation-only and must not be mixed into training data.
